# Registry entry schema

One file per tool in registry/&lt;name&gt;.yaml. Check an entry with `relgap registry lint`. The schema is served at [/schemas/registry-v1.json](/schemas/registry-v1.json), and
editors that read the `yaml-language-server` comment check an entry as you type.

```yaml
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/schemas/registry-v1.json
```

| Key | Type | Required | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aliases` | list of strings |  |  | Other names that resolve to this tool, such as tf or KUBECTL_VERSION. |
| `bin` | list of strings |  | pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$` | Executable names that outdated --binaries looks for. Empty means the tool name. |
| `breaking_markers` | list of strings |  |  | Regular expressions; an entry whose text matches one is breaking, such as ACTION REQUIRED. |
| [`eol`](#eol) | object |  |  |  |
| `min_relgap` | string |  | pattern `^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$` | Oldest relgap version that understands this entry. |
| `name` | string | yes | pattern `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$` | Canonical tool name; must match the file name. |
| [`osv`](#osv) | list of objects |  |  |  |
| `repo` | string | yes | pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$` | GitHub owner/repo. |
| [`sources`](#sources) | list of objects |  |  | Changelog sources, tried and merged in order. Empty means auto-discovery. |
| [`version`](#version) | object |  |  |  |

## eol

| Key | Type | Required | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `eol.cycle` | string |  |  | Cycle template such as {major}.{minor}. |
| `eol.product` | string | yes |  | endoflife.date product. |

## osv

| Key | Type | Required | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `osv[].ecosystem` | string | yes |  | OSV ecosystem such as Go, npm, PyPI or crates.io. GIT takes the repository URL as name and queries the version's tag. |
| `osv[].name` | string | yes |  |  |

## sources

Changelog sources, tried and merged in order. Empty means auto-discovery.

| Key | Type | Required | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sources[].anchor` | string |  |  | web-doc: id of a version's element on the page, with the path_template placeholders, such as go{version}. |
| `sources[].content` | string |  |  | web-doc: selector (tag, #id and .class without spaces) of the element to convert. Default main, else body. |
| `sources[].content_dir` | string |  |  | changelog-file: the Hugo content directory in the repository, such as website/content/en. Default: the path up to the last content/ directory, plus a language directory after it. |
| `sources[].from_heading` | string |  |  | Heading whose section holds the upgrade notes. |
| `sources[].heading` | string |  |  | Regular expression for a version's heading; {version} is replaced first. |
| `sources[].ignore_sections` | list of strings |  |  | Headings, or heading paths joined with " › ", whose entries are dropped. A heading matches when it equals the item or starts with it and a space. |
| `sources[].json` | object |  |  | structured-json: how each JSON document becomes entries. |
| `sources[].json.heading` | string |  |  | Field whose value groups entries under a heading, such as type. |
| `sources[].json.items` | string |  |  | Dotted path to the array of entries; empty means the document is the array. |
| `sources[].json.link` | string |  |  | Field holding a URL for the entry. |
| `sources[].json.text` | string | yes |  | Entry text with {field} placeholders, such as {category}: {description}. |
| `sources[].kind` | string | yes | `gh-release`, `changelog-file`, `structured-json`, `web-doc`, `upgrade-guide`, `upgrade-notes` |  |
| `sources[].path_template` | string |  |  | File path in the repo. Placeholders: {version}, {major}, {minor} (the minor number alone) and {tag}; upgrade-guide also has {prev_minor} (such as 3.5) and {prev_major}. |
| `sources[].ref` | string |  |  | Git ref; may be a template such as v{major}.{minor}. |
| `sources[].site_url` | string |  | pattern `^https://` | changelog-file: base URL of the project's Hugo site. Hugo ref and relref links in the file point at its pages; without it they keep their text and lose the link. |
| `sources[].strip` | list of strings |  |  | web-doc: selectors of elements dropped before converting, such as a.headerlink. |
| `sources[].url_template` | string |  | pattern `^https://` | https URL on a host relgap allows (go.dev, docs.python.org, api.adoptium.net); same placeholders as path_template. |

Each source kind needs these keys:

| Kind | Required keys |
|---|---|
| `gh-release` | none besides `kind` |
| `changelog-file` | `path_template` |
| `structured-json` | `json`, and one of `path_template` or `url_template` |
| `web-doc` | `url_template` |
| `upgrade-guide` | one of `path_template` or `url_template` |
| `upgrade-notes` | `from_heading` |

## version

| Key | Type | Required | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version.exclude` | string |  |  | Regular expression on the tag; matching tags are ignored. |
| `version.extract` | string |  |  | Regular expression for scheme regex; capture groups are joined with dots. |
| `version.line` | string |  | `none`, `major`, `minor` | Default release line for the end of a range. |
| `version.scheme` | string |  | `semver`, `loose`, `calver`, `python`, `regex` | How tags are parsed and ordered. Default loose. |
| `version.tag_prefix` | string |  |  | Stripped from tags before parsing; tags without it are ignored. |
| `version.universe` | string |  | `releases`, `tags` | What defines the versions in a range. Default releases. |
